g.text: ok 1 - urgency: the pool nearer its reset ranks first when both are equally behind
ok 2 - final window lifts a behind API pool above a free pool; outside it the free pool wins
ok 3 - ties within the margin go to the earliest reset, then the cheaper pool
ok 4 - private work is refused by pools without "private": true
ok 5 - stale or missing readings: exit 3 when nothing else can take the work
ok 6 - a reading from a cycle that has since reset counts as 0 used
ok 7 - batch: on for a batch-capable pick; off for --now, --human-waiting and a reset under batchMin
Hours
ok 8 - a subscription ahead of its line is a last resort; behind it, it burns first
ok 9 - blocks: blockedUntil takes a pool out until then; blockedModels falls through to the next mod
el
ok 10 - time windows: wrap past midnight, --minutes must fit, no new starts after a cut-off
ok 11 - cycleBounds: monthly resets clamp to short months and honour the offset; periodic cycles rol
l from the anchor
ok 12 - content scan reports type and line, never the value; allow-listed e-mails and custom pattern
s
ok 13 - CLI: a scanned file with a fake key routes as private and never echoes the key
ok 14 - CLI: the example config routes bulk to api-main with a ranked chain
ok 15 - CLI: stale usage file -> exit 3
ok 16 - bad usage -> exit 2 with a JSON error
